name: GitHub Spec Kit (specify CLI)
description: Installs GitHub's spec-kit `specify` CLI, along with the required Python runtime, via uv. Depends on the uv Feature (ghcr.io/va-h/devcontainers-features/uv:1) for the `uv`/`uvx` tooling.

pythonVersion.description: Python version installed via uv and used to run spec-kit.

specKitRepository.description: Git URL that uv installs the specify-cli tool from (spec-kit source repository).
